Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses STATE BANK OF INDIA Administrative Office, Raipur Websites: https://gem.gov.in/ | www.sbi.bank.in NOTICE INVITING E-TENDER FOR SBI HOLIDAY HOME AT RAIPUR, CHHATISGARH E-Tender in Two Bid System (i.e., technical bid and Financial bid) through e-procurement solution for Two fully furnished Double Bed Rooms are invited from Agencies/Hotels/Resorts for Holiday Home services at RAIPUR, CHHATISGARH for a period of two years under two bid system, which may be extended for a su itable period on mutual agreement, subject to satisfactory performance on the same terms and conditions. Important Dates for Inviting e-Tender Event Details Date of release of NIT As on GeM Last Date of Submission of Tender As on GeM Date of Opening of Tender As on GeM Date of Opening Technical Bid As on GeM Date of Opening Financial Bid As on GeM Instructions for Online Bid Submission (Annexure-A) 1. The bidders are required to submit signed soft copies of their bids on the GeM portal. 2. Details of tender documents are available for viewing and downloading on the websites https://gem. gov.in/ and www.sbi.bank.in . 3. Selection of the successful bidder will be at the sole discretion of the STATE BANK OF INDIA who res erves the right to accept or reject any or all offers without assigning any reasons thereof. Preparation of Bids 1. Bidder should consider any corrigendum published on the Gem before submitting their bids. 2. Please go through the tender advertisement and the tender document carefully to understand the d ocuments required to be submitted as part of the bid. Please note the number of covers in which th e bid documents must be submitted, the number of documents including the names and content of each of the document that need to be submitted. Any deviations from these may lead to rejection of the bid. 3. Bidder, in advance, should get ready the bid documents to be submitted as indicated in the tender document. Submission of Bids 1. Bidder should log into the site well in advance for bid submission so that they can upload the bid in

time (i.e., on or before the bid submission time). Bidder will be responsible for any delay due to oth er issues. 2. The bidder must sign and upload the required bid documents one by one as indicated in the tender document. 3. Bidders are requested to note that they should necessarily submit their financial bids in the format provided on GeM; no other format is acceptable. Assistance to Bidders Any queries relating to the tender document and the terms and conditions contained therein should be add ressed to the Tender Inviting Authority for a tender or the relevant contact person indicated in the tender, or they may call on working days between 09:45 AM to 05:30 PM. Documents to be Submitted with Technical Bid for Assessment 1. Document for authenticating the premises and ownership along with blueprint of the structure/buildi ng. 2. PAN No. issued by the Income Tax Department for TDS purposes. 3. GST Registration No. issued by the GST Department. 4. Duly filled and signed form as in Form-A. 5. Details of other organizations to whom TOR/Holiday Home/Guest House services are/were being pro vided, in the Proforma enclosed at Annexure-I. 6. Proforma pertaining to "Yes/No" for the required documents at Annexure-II completed and submitte d. 7. Annexure-I to V must be duly filled and signed. 8. Each page of the tender document should be signed and submitted along with other documents. Terms and Conditions 1. The bidder shall provide Two AC Double Bedrooms for Holiday Home for AO, SBI at RAIPUR, CHHATIS GARH on a Monthly Rental basis preferably at first floor/second floor/ground floor duly connected by a working lift. The size of each room should not be less than 200 sq. ft. 2. The Holiday Home shall be in a decent location with greenery around, easily approachable, and acc essible via public transport. The hotel should have its own car parking service facility for enough ve hicles for SBI guests. 3. The accommodation should normally be provided for two adults and two children in each room. In c ase of necessity, one additional bed will be provided without any extra charge to the visitors. 4. An adequate number of blankets (minimum 02 nos.) must be provided without any extra charge. 5. The rooms shall have facilities like one king-size bed, sofa, dustbin, tea table with teapot, wardrobe/ closet with sufficient hangers, functional LCD/LED TV with remote, internet/Wi-Fi connection, electri c kettle with tea/coffee/sugar sachets, bath towels and hand towels (02 each), and toiletry kit (sham poo, toothpaste, soap, shower gel). 6. Each bedroom shall be provided with a functional Air Conditioner. 7. Each bedroom shall have one attached bathroom. 8. Each bathroom shall have a geyser (ISI Mark), buckets, mugs, floor mats, dustbin, soap, hand wash, shampoo, etc. 9. The lessor/First Party shall maintain a "Suggestion Register" at the reception desk so that managem ent can be promptly notified in case of service deficiencies. Power backup shall be ensured by the F irst Party. 10. The cost of the caretaker/staff will not be borne by SBI. 11. Necessary arrangements for locking and opening of the rooms shall be made. 12. Arrangements are to be made to get the room cleaned every day. 13. Linen/bedding is to be changed every day when the room is occupied. 14. Curtains are to be cleaned periodically. 15. 24-hour power backup must be ensured. 16. The rooms allotted to SBI shall not be sublet, nor shall possession of the premises or any part thereo f be transferred without prior written consent from SBI. 17. The rooms allotted to SBI shall normally be kept locked and shall not be allotted to anyone except S BI employees/guests officially authorized with an official letter. 18. A waiver of service charge (if any) and a minimum 15% discount on food bills must be provided if di ning in the hotel. 19. Complimentary tea/coffee and Breakfast to be provided to each guest. 20. 24x7 room service must be available. 21. Bed linens and towels to be changed every day; curtains to be washed at regular intervals. 22. Check-in time is 1:00 PM and check-out time is 12:00 Noon.

23. Income Tax/TDS, as per rules, shall be deducted from the bills of the successful bidder. 24. SBI reserves the right to terminate the contract by giving at least one month’s notice. 25. In the event of a dispute, the decision of the SBI AO, Raipur, CHHATISGARH shall be final and bindin g. 26. The courts at Raipur alone shall have jurisdiction over any matter arising out of or relating to this ag reement. 27. The SBI Administrative Office, Raipur reserves the right to accept or reject summarily any or all tend ers in whole or in part without assigning any reason whatsoever. 28. Incomplete tenders will not be accepted. 29. The rate quoted by the hotel should be inclusive of all taxes/municipal taxes including GST. 30. The final selection of the bidder shall be considered only after physical verification of the hotel durin g technical evaluation by a representative of SBI. 31. The agreement shall be entered into for an initial period of two years, extendable by up to 01 additi onal year upon satisfactory service and mutual consent. 32. The successful bidder will have the right to terminate the contract by giving a 02-month notice. 33. The successful bidder must obtain feedback from SBI guests using the prescribed proforma and encl ose all completed forms with the monthly bill. 34. Uninterrupted 24-hour water and electricity supply shall be maintained throughout the year by the b idder, including power backup arrangements. 35. The hotel must have properly trained housekeeping/front desk staff present, and security personnel must be on duty 24x7. Security Deposit & Penalty Clause Security Deposit 1. The successful bidder will be required to deposit a Security Deposit at the rate of 5% of the contra ct value for contract fulfilment. The amount is payable via Demand Draft in Favor of "Chief Mana ger (HR) AO Raipur" or as an e-Performance Bank Guarantee valid for sixty (60) days beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations also submit EMD in Name of "Chief Manager ( HR) AO Raipur" 2. The security deposit must be submitted within fifteen (15) days from the date of tender acceptance, failing which SBI reserves the right to cancel the award. In case of any breach, delay, default, or lap se, the contract shall be terminated without assigning reasons and the deposit will be forfeited. 3. The bid must be accompanied by a Bid Securing Declaration as detailed in Annexure-V. Penalty Clause For all terms and conditions default/breach, a penalty of Rs. 1,000/- per default will be deducted f rom the bill. If stay is not provided after booking confirmation, the respective number of days' rent along with th e Rs. 1,000/- penalty will be deducted. Cumulative penalties shall not exceed 10% of the total contract value. If breached, the contract will be terminated without further warning. .
